description: This file defines an abstract base class 'HTMLPurifier_Token' which serves as a parent class for various token types used in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties related to token position, processing exemptions, and methods for property access and position setting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token
classes.description: An abstract base class for tokens in the HTMLPurifier library. Defines common properties for token position, exemption armor, and methods for position management and type identification.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Provides a deprecated way to get the token's type as a string based on its class name, triggering a user notice when called.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Sets the line and column position of the token within the source document.

methods.name: rawPosition
methods.description: Sets the position with special handling if the column is -1, used during direct lexical processing.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: An abstract method that must be implemented in subclasses to convert the token into a corresponding node structure.
